Maya (Product): dropped a compact billing-row mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-billing -> goal: make token breakdown legible at a glance while keeping rows dense. Tess (Design Ops): two quick variants: inline micro-pills next to sparkline, or a single compact summary with chevron to expand. Desktop favors pills, mobile favors expand. Sam (PM): growth prefers visible numbers (no hover). inline pills probably better for conversion. Leo (Eng): perf note: rendering thousands of pill DOM nodes causes paint jank. suggestion: backend returns three aggregated numbers per row and we render them as a single inline text chunk or lightweight SVG, not separate heavy DOM elements. Anya (A11y): avoid hover-only. pills must be keyboard-focusable and announced by screen readers. propose a single aria-label summarizing the breakdown. check color contrast for pill text in dark mode (need 4.5:1). Maya (Product): propose: desktop = inline pills visible; mobile = tap-to-expand; keyboard = focus reveals pills; copy change: "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Monthly cost estimate". John (Revenue): CSV/export must map visible numbers to columns. suggested headers: transaction_id,account_id,project_id,token_category,tokens,cost_usd,date. Sam (PM): add small tooltip on pill focus/hover linking to invoice detail. keeps card compact but surfaces exact counts. Leo (Eng): tooltip ok if we lazy-init DOM and reuse aggregated payload. we'll also precompute 7-point aggregates for the sparkline to reduce render cost. Anya (A11y): aria snippet to include:
Summary: 5.5k tokens
Dev-bot: preview build #501 pushed to preview branch: https://preview.redwood/branch/compact-billing-501 and snapshot: https://ci.redwood/snapshots/501 Tess (Design Ops): I'll upload final mocks with annotated color tokens and mobile flow by EOD. Maya (Product): decision summary: desktop inline pills (render as lightweight text/SVG), mobile expand on tap, keyboard focus reveals, copy -> "Monthly cost estimate", CSV includes token->cost mapping. Eng to run perf checks on low-end devices after mocks land; John to review CSV schema. I'll post a Loom once mocks and perf checks are done. :white_check_mark:
